policies.title: Qatari ordinary passports: Jordan visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official Tourism Board nationality table states that Qatari visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Jordan's current visitor guidance requires non-Jordanian travellers to obtain a Gateway2Jordan QR code before departure.
Passport validity, purpose, permitted ports, security screening and final admission remain applicable; work, residence and special documents are outside scope.

policies.title: Qatari ordinary passports: Ukraine short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Ukraine's in-force bilateral agreement exempts ordinary Qatari passports from visas for entry, stay, exit and transit up to 90 days in 180 days.
conditions: The waiver applies to ordinary Qatari passports valid for at least six months from entry and permits up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
Employment, residence, special-document travel, temporarily occupied-territory permissions and final admission remain outside this ordinary short-visitor baseline.

policies.title: Qatari ordinary passports: Iraq advance visit visa
policies.summary: Qatar's Embassy in Baghdad directs regular Qatari passport holders to obtain an Iraqi visit visa from the nearest Iraqi embassy before departure.
conditions: The embassy describes a 30-day citizen stay and a visit visa issued by the nearest Iraqi embassy before departure.
Iraqi-origin, residence, work, special-document, regional and final-admission treatment remain outside this ordinary visitor policy.

policies.title: Qatari ordinary passports: Turkmenistan advance visit visa
policies.summary: Qatar's Embassy in Ashgabat says regular Qatari passports require a visit visa issued by a Turkmenistan embassy before departure.
conditions: The cited mission guidance distinguishes regular passports from diplomatic and special passports, which have separate treatment.
Invitation, transit, work, residence, special-document and final-admission requirements remain outside this ordinary visitor baseline.

conflicts.explanation: Qatar's current Baghdad Embassy guidance directs regular passports to obtain a visit visa from the nearest Iraqi embassy before departure, rather than establishing electronic issuance.
Jordan's live official nationality table says that Qatar's visa can be obtained on arrival; this is not a visa exemption.
